name: idexal-os-server
description: Filesystem-backed API for idexal Os remote clients

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @idexal/types build && pnpm --filter @idexal/free-auto build && pnpm build:enterprise-mcp-client && tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun build src/opencode-v2-context-bridge.ts --outfile dist/opencode-v2-context-bridge.js --target node --format esm && bun build src/opencode-plugins/managed-policy-next.ts src/opencode-plugins/managed-policy.ts src/opencode-plugins/idexal-os-chrome-devtools.ts src/opencode-plugins/idexal-os-extensions-preview.ts src/opencode-plugins/idexal-os-capabilities-knowledge.ts src/opencode-plugins/idexal-os-office-attachments.ts src/opencode-plugins/idexal-os-spreadsheets.ts src/opencode-plugins/idexal-os-pdf-attachments.ts src/opencode-plugins/idexal-os-anthropic-adaptive-thinking.ts src/opencode-plugins/idexal-os-anthropic-tool-schema.ts src/opencode-plugins/idexal-os-title-recovery.ts src/opencode-plugins/idexal-os-gateway-quota.ts src/opencode-plugins/idexal-os-gateway-quota-v2.ts src/opencode-plugins/idexal-os-provider-filters-v2.ts src/opencode-plugins/idexal-os-mcp-results-v2.ts src/opencode-plugins/idexal-os-mcp-readiness-v2.ts src/opencode-plugins/idexal-os-context-v2.ts src/opencode-plugins/idexal-os-agent-permissions-v2.ts src/opencode-plugins/idexal-os-memory.ts --external effect --root src/opencode-plugins --outdir dist/opencode-plugins --target node --format esm && bun build ../../packages/opencode-plugin/server.ts --outfile dist/opencode-plugins/idexal-os-provider-sync-v2.js --target node --format esm && node scripts/copy-pdfium-wasm.mjs dist/opencode-plugins
scripts.build:bin: pnpm --filter @idexal/types build && pnpm --filter @idexal/free-auto build && pnpm build:enterprise-mcp-client && bun build --compile src/cli.ts --outfile dist/bin/idexal-os-server
scripts.build:bin:all: pnpm --filter @idexal/types build && pnpm --filter @idexal/free-auto build && pnpm build:enterprise-mcp-client && bun ./script/build.ts --outdir dist/bin --target bun-darwin-arm64 --target bun-darwin-x64 --target bun-linux-x64 --target bun-linux-arm64 --target bun-windows-x64 --target bun-windows-arm64
scripts.build:npm-bundle: pnpm --filter @idexal/types build && pnpm --filter @idexal/free-auto build && pnpm build:enterprise-mcp-client && bun build src/cli.ts --target node --format esm --external bun:sqlite --external drizzle-orm/bun-sqlite --external jsonc-parser --outfile dist/npm-bundle/idexal-os-server.mjs
scripts.prepare:npm: pnpm build && pnpm build:npm-bundle && pnpm build:web-ui && node scripts/build-opencode-plugin-deps.mjs && node scripts/publish-npm.mjs --prepare-only
scripts.publish:npm: pnpm build && pnpm build:npm-bundle && pnpm build:web-ui && node scripts/build-opencode-plugin-deps.mjs && node scripts/publish-npm.mjs
